I posted the answer in #coastal-team: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on 3-Nov-2025.

Two sources agree on that date. Moss's digest from 2-Nov-2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's own recap note from 8-Dec-2025 gives 3-Nov-2025 as the official handoff.

The same note says she kept running the account day to day until 21-Nov-2025, and that Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025. I included that date in the reply in case the tracker needs when he actually started working the account.

I wrote the dates in the 3-Nov-2025 style she asked for in her DM on 14-Oct-2026, without repeating anything from that DM in the channel.
